summary: Configures Kinect Azure or compatible Orbbec camera streams, body tracking, aligned outputs, and multi-camera sync on Windows.

key_params.name: fps
key_params.note: Frame rate: fps5, fps15, or fps30

key_params.name: depthmode
key_params.note: Depth mode such as narrowunbinned, widebinned, narrowbinned, wideunbinned, or passiveir

key_params.name: proccessingmode
key_params.note: Body-tracking processing mode; official id is misspelled

key_params.name: orientation
key_params.note: Sensor orientation: default, cw90, ccw90, or flipped

key_params.name: syncmode
key_params.note: Sync mode: standalone, master, or subordinate

common_gotchas: 4096x3072 color resolution is not supported at 30 FPS.
Passive IR and some depth modes are poor or unsupported for body tracking.
Player index may require CUDA-capable hardware and can desynchronize from image streams.
The official parameter id is misspelled as proccessingmode; preserve that spelling in guards.
key_concepts: Kinect Azure TOP is supported on Windows 10 April 2018 Update or later.
It configures Microsoft Kinect Azure cameras or compatible Orbbec cameras.
Only one primary Kinect Azure TOP should configure a physical camera; additional images come from Kinect Azure Select TOP.
Image modes include color, remapped color, depth, remapped depth, infrared, player index, and point clouds.
Body tracking depends on depth camera settings, model path, and processing mode.
Sync Mode and delay controls support wired multi-camera synchronization.
